versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetImage|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
filter_main_system:
    SourceImage: 'C:\Windows\System32\csrss.exe'
filter_optional_defender:
    SourceImage|endswith: '\MsMpEng.exe'
filter_optional_malwarebytes:
    SourceImage: 'C:\Program Files\Malwarebytes\Anti-Malware\MBAMService.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*

versions.subject: Merge PR #5513 from @swachchhanda000 - fix FPs observed via Aurora
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetImage|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
filter_main_system:
    SourceImage|startswith:
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\'
filter_optional_defender:
    SourceImage|endswith: '\MsMpEng.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
versions.spl: TargetImage IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") NOT (SourceImage IN ("C:\\Windows\\System32\\*", "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*", "C:\\Program Files\\*")) NOT SourceImage="*\\MsMpEng.exe"
